objective: Implement PRD-defined configuration, schemas, artifact contracts, privacy defaults, validation, and structured output guarantees.
implemented_contracts: relia check validates Phase 0 relia.yaml defaults from parsed YAML structure instead of raw text snippets.
Unsafe redaction defaults fail closed when entropy_scan is false even if entropy_scan: true appears in a comment.
Phase 0 outcome schema enums use the PRD outcome taxonomy: ci_failure, revert, review_correction, merge_clean, and fix_held.
Failure signature schema class values use PRD signature classes: test_failure, lint_failure, type_failure, build_failure, and unknown.
The Phase 0 architecture decision note documents the standard-library YAML subset parser used for bootstrap config validation.

review_findings_repaired.summary: Parse relia.yaml before accepting redaction defaults.
Use the PRD outcome taxonomy in schemas.
Allow failure-signature classes, not outcome kinds.
